label: Freshly verified
scope: Read-only fixed map catalog metadata, new-store aggregate counts and non-secret schema ledger; no app/Auth-user content

policies.using_expression:
(qualified AND (EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM (mi_map_private.publication_heads h
     JOIN mi_map_private.rights_controls r ON ((r.clearance_id = catalog_releases.clearance_id)))
  WHERE ((h.release_id = catalog_releases.release_id) AND (h.state = 'published'::text) AND (r.state = 'cleared'::text) AND r.allow_ui AND (r.valid_until > clock_timestamp())))))

(EXISTS ( SELECT 1
   FROM mi_map_private.catalog_releases r
  WHERE (r.release_id = observations.release_id)))

securityAdvisor.scope: Only map-related advisor output retained; unrelated existing notices neither changed nor copied
